description:
## What

Multipurpose-generation sibling to `SmimeOrganizationValidated` (the
Org Strict tier, pending PKIX-jbvb.1). Per CA/B Forum S/MIME BR
§7.1.6.1: Multipurpose certs assert policy OID `2.23.140.1.5.2.2` and
permit additional EKU values beyond `emailProtection`.

## API shape

```rust
pub struct SmimeOrganizationValidatedMultipurpose;

impl Profile for SmimeOrganizationValidatedMultipurpose {
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str { "cabf.smime.organization.multipurpose" }
    fn version(&self) -> &'static str { "1.0.14" }
    fn policy(&self, now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy {
        // Baseline same as SmimeOrganizationValidated (Strict), with:
        // - required_leaf_policy_oids: [2.23.140.1.5.2.2]
        // - EKU permissiveness per §7.1.2.3(f) Multipurpose row
    }
}

pub const fn smime_org_multipurpose_policy(now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy { ... }
```

## Subject DN rule

Per §7.1.4.2.4 (Organization-validated) Multipurpose column: same as
Strict — `AllOf(organizationName, organizationIdentifier)`. Tier-
distinguishing attributes (givenName/surname/pseudonym) SHALL NOT.

## OID constant

Add `CABF_SMIME_ORGANIZATION_VALIDATED_MULTIPURPOSE_POLICY` =
`ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap("2.23.140.1.5.2.2")`.

## Test fixture

Generate `smime-org-multipurpose-self-signed-365d.der` via extension to
`gen-smime-tier-fixtures.py`. Subject DN: C, O, organizationIdentifier, CN.

## Acceptance

- Type, alias, OID constant ship.
- Tests: positive (the new fixture) + negative (Org Strict cert
  fails this Profile by policy-OID mismatch, and vice versa).
- CHANGELOG + divergences.md updated.
- Same clippy/fmt/test bars as PKIX-jbvb.9.2.

## Blocks on

- **PKIX-jbvb.1** — Org Strict (`SmimeOrganizationValidated`) must
  ship first; this is the structural template (DN rules + OID
  constants for Org tier). Same blocked-on pattern as
  PKIX-jbvb.9.2 → .9.1.
